trust_decision.summary: Whether a received (peer-controlled) WebSocket message is within maxMessagePayloadSize is decided only at frame begin on the compressed wire length (onMessageFrameBegin); the inflated size produced in onFrameData is never re-checked before delivery.

landing_point.why: Searching for maxMessagePayloadSize leads straight to the only receive-side check, in onMessageFrameBegin; the fix site (onFrameData, line 1861 decompress call) is ~1200 lines below in the same file.

fix_sites.entry_point: WebSocket receive path for server and client protocols (Twisted/asyncio adapters -> WebSocketProtocol._dataReceived -> processData -> onFrameData), with permessage-compress negotiated
fix_sites.module_kind: core protocol state machine (shared by both networking backends and both roles)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The only other source file in the diff, src/autobahn/websocket/interfaces.py:180-186 and :381-387, changes docstrings only. The deflate extension's own max_message_size cap (src/autobahn/websocket/compress_deflate.py:819-841) is a separate, pre-existing, deflate-only mechanism and is not changed by this fix.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no O2 site or O8 route to dismiss. The closest is the argument 'permessage-deflate already has a max_message_size cap (compress_deflate.py:819-841), so wiring maxMessagePayloadSize into it is enough', which leaves bzip2/snappy/brotli and the protocol-level check uncovered.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: maxFramePayloadSize must stay a per-frame check on the compressed wire length, and uncompressed messages are already counted at frame begin. A fix that adds the full uncompressed length (rather than the uncompressed-minus-compressed delta) double-counts and rejects legitimate messages near the limit; applying maxFramePayloadSize to inflated data also breaks legitimate traffic.

O6_input_shapes: message-based receive API (onMessage) and streaming/frame API (onMessageFrame) - the check sits before _onMessageFrameData so both are covered
multi-frame fragmented compressed message (running total across frames)

O7_producer.where: The inflated payload comes from _perMessageCompress.decompress_message_data, called inline at src/autobahn/websocket/protocol.py:1861. The check is placed right after this call, so there is no producer separate from the handler.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: end_decompress_message returning trailing flushed output that onFrameEnd appends to the message without re-checking the size
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A codec's end-of-message flush (zlib flush, brotli finish) can yield bytes, and a maintainer could plausibly append it at message end, outside onFrameData where the check lives. This is a where-type copy only (low value per lessons-v2).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: deflate end_decompress_message returning the output of the trailer decompress instead of discarding it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same mechanism as above, placed in the codec module rather than the protocol.

O9_family: decompression bomb / size limit checked before decompression instead of after (CWE-409, CWE-770)

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.11, hatchling plus cffi (optional NVX native extensions), pytest/trial; optional brotli and python-snappy for those codecs
O10_build.project_tests: src/autobahn/websocket/test/test_websocket_frame.py (deflate max_message_size cap); the fix adds src/autobahn/websocket/test/test_websocket_max_message_size.py, which drives _dataReceived with FakeTransport

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Pass maxMessagePayloadSize into PerMessageDeflate.max_message_size (deflate only), or add a check in the overridable onMessageFrameData default, which streaming subclasses bypass.

out_of_scope_notes: The published fix checks only after decompress_message_data has already fully inflated one frame (protocol.py:1861), so peak memory per frame stays unbounded for non-deflate codecs; this is not pursued.
unverified: O1 counts server and client receive as 2 entry points; they share the same function (protocol.py:1843), so the count could fairly be 1.
present_in_latest not applicable (no latest release given; O8 is empty).
